title: Hypouricemic and nephroprotective effects of palmatine from Cortex Phellodendri Amurensis: A uric acid modulator targeting Keap1-Nrf2/NLRP3 axis.
authors: Ai, Gaoxiang; Huang, Ronglei; Xie, Jianhui; Zhong, Linjiang; Wu, Xiaoyan; Qin, Zehui; Su, Ziren; Chen, Jiannan; Yang, Xiaobo; Dou, Yaoxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分巴马汀对高尿酸血症小鼠的降尿酸及肾保护作用，涉及Keap1-Nrf2/NLRP3通路和分子对接，但核心是药物药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Palmatine (Pal) is a major bioactive alkaloid originated from ancient Chinese herbal medicine Cortex Phellodendri Amurensis (CPA), which has long been applied to treat hyperuricemia (HUA)-related diseases. Pal possesses potent anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant effects against metabolic diseases. However, its potential beneficial effect against PO (potassium oxonate)/HX (hypoxanthine)-induced HUA remains elusive. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the potential pharmacological effect and mechanism of Pal on PO/HX-induced HUA in mice. MATERIAL AND METHODS: A mouse model of HUA was established by co-administration of PO/HX once daily for 7 consecutive days. The HUA mice were orally given three doses (25, 50 and 100 mg/kg) of Pal daily for a week. Febuxostat (Feb, 5 mg/kg) was given as a positive control. At the scheduled termination of the experiment, the whole blood, liver and kidney were collected for subsequent analyses. The concentrations of uric acid (UA), creatinine (CRE) and blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and activities of adenosine deaminase (ADA) and xanthine oxidase (XOD) were evaluated. Histopathological alterations of the kidney were detected by H&E staining. The inflammatory and oxidative stress status was detected by assay kits. Additionally, key proteins involved in the urate transporter, Keap1-Nrf2 and TXNIP/NLRP3 signaling pathways were evaluated by immunohistochemistry and Western blotting. Finally, molecular docking was employed to probe the binding characteristics of Pal and target proteins Keap1, NLRP3, URAT1 and HO-1. RESULTS: Administration of Pal substantially decreased the elevated kidney weight, lowered UA, CRE and BUN levels, and attenuated abnormal histopathological alterations. Meanwhile, treatment with Pal also dramatically lowered hepatic XOD and ADA activities. Besides, Pal treatment effectively mitigated the renal inflammatory and oxidative stress markers. Further mechanistic investigation indicated Pal distinctly downregulated the protein levels of GLUT9 and URAT1, while up-regulated the expression levels of OAT1 and ABCG2. Pal also restored Nrf2 activation, promoted subsequent expression of anti-oxidative enzymes, and downregulated the expressions of TXNIP, NLRP3, apoptosis-associated speck-like (ASC), caspase-1, IL-1beta and IL-18. Molecular docking analysis also indicated Pal firmly bound with Keap1, NLRP3, URAT1 and HO-1. CONCLUSIONS: These findings indicated that Pal exhibited favorable anti-HUA effect via modulating the expressions of transporter-related proteins and suppressing XOD activity. Furthermore, Pal also alleviated HUA-induced kidney injury, which was at least partially related to restoring Keap1-Nrf2 pathway and inhibiting TXNIP/NLRP3 inflammasome. Our investigation was envisaged to provide experimental support for the traditional application of CPA and CPA-containing classical herbal formulas in the management of HUA-related diseases and might provide novel dimension to the clinical application of Pal.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：巴马汀（Palmatine, Pal）是一种源自古老中药黄柏（Cortex Phellodendri Amurensis, CPA）的主要生物活性生物碱，长期用于治疗高尿酸血症（hyperuricemia, HUA）相关疾病。Pal 对代谢性疾病具有强效的抗炎和抗氧化作用。然而，其对氧嗪酸钾（potassium oxonate, PO）/次黄嘌呤（hypoxanthine, HX）诱导的 HUA 的潜在有益作用仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨 Pal 对 PO/HX 诱导的小鼠 HUA 的潜在药理作用及其机制。材料与方法：通过连续 7 天每日联合给予 PO/HX 建立小鼠 HUA 模型。HUA 小鼠每日口服三种剂量（25、50 和 100 mg/kg）的 Pal，持续一周。非布司他（Febuxostat, Feb, 5 mg/kg）作为阳性对照。在实验预定终止时，收集全血、肝脏和肾脏用于后续分析。评估了尿酸（uric acid, UA）、肌酐（creatinine, CRE）和血尿素氮（blood urea nitrogen, BUN）的浓度，以及腺苷脱氨酶（adenosine deaminase, ADA）和黄嘌呤氧化酶（xanthine oxidase, XOD）的活性。通过 H&E 染色检测肾脏的组织病理学变化。使用检测试剂盒评估炎症和氧化应激状态。此外，通过免疫组织化学和 Western blotting 评估了参与尿酸盐转运蛋白、Keap1-Nrf2 和 TXNIP/NLRP3 信号通路的关键蛋白。最后，采用分子对接探讨 Pal 与靶蛋白 Keap1、NLRP3、URAT1 和 HO-1 的结合特性。结果：给予 Pal 显著降低了升高的肾脏重量，降低了 UA、CRE 和 BUN 水平，并减轻了异常的组织病理学变化。同时，Pal 治疗也显著降低了肝脏 XOD 和 ADA 活性。此外，Pal 治疗有效缓解了肾脏炎症和氧化应激标志物。进一步的机制研究表明，Pal 明显下调了 GLUT9 和 URAT1 的蛋白水平，同时上调了 OAT1 和 ABCG2 的表达水平。Pal 还恢复了 Nrf2 的激活，促进了后续抗氧化酶的表达，并下调了 TXNIP、NLRP3、凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（apoptosis-associated speck-like, ASC）、caspase-1、IL-1β 和 IL-18 的表达。分子对接分析也表明 Pal 与 Keap1、NLRP3、URAT1 和 HO-1 牢固结合。结论：这些发现表明，Pal 通过调节转运体相关蛋白的表达和抑制 XOD 活性，表现出良好的抗 HUA 作用。此外，Pal 还减轻了 HUA 诱导的肾损伤，这至少部分与恢复 Keap1-Nrf2 通路和抑制 TXNIP/NLRP3 炎症小体有关。我们的研究旨在为 CPA 及含 CPA 的经典方剂在 HUA 相关疾病管理中的传统应用提供实验支持，并可能为 Pal 的临床应用提供新的维度。
